name: Cool Game Pack
description:
About This Game

Cool Game Pack is a cozy bundle of ten pick-up-and-play logic, casual, and reflex games designed to entertain players of all ages and skill levels. Satisfying to master, and perfect for quick sessions or relaxed evenings. Whether you're looking for a quick brain teaser or an immersive, challenging experience, Cool Game Pack has something for everyone.
Our carefully curated selection spans a wide range of gameplay mechanics, so there’s always a fresh challenge to crack. Each game is handcrafted and tuned with a strong "just one more level" hook, easy to start and rewarding to master, inviting you to try new ideas, solve smart, and outscore your friends.

Games in pack:

BAY BREAKER  - Inspired by the classics, set sail across serene seas. Take the helm of a small boat and launch ultra-springy balls to crack tough rock formations and crystal blocks. Along the way, uncover hidden jewels and ancient coins tucked into the levels. As you progress, earn magical enchantments that expand your abilities and enjoy smooth, satisfying physics with a gentle maritime vibe.
Features:
► A fresh twist on the Arkanoid concept
► Crisp HD visuals and an upbeat soundtrack
► Satisfying, true-to-physics ricochets
► 30 hand-made levels + Endless Mode
► Achievements and in-game rewards


BALLOBALL - Ribbit & Rescue - is a bright, cartoon arcade game starring a playful forest guardian on a mission to free frogs trapped in bubbles by evil fairies. Use your hero’s agility to dodge traps, then rely on physics based trajectories to line up the perfect launch and pop the bubbles. Miss the first try? Adjust your angle, learn the arc, and try again until every frog is safe.
Features:
► Playful, exciting gameplay
► Physics-driven action with clean ricochets and clever trick shots
► Cool hand-drawn visuals
► Expressive, funny character animations
► Stylish, atmospheric soundtrack


BOOL CAPTURE - You are trapped inside a glitching program. Your mission is simple: clear the field of hostile red system balls and capture the yellow ones. The COREDROM system is recovering. Can you finish before it’s too late?
Features:
► Simple, unique gameplay
► Retro vibes
► Immersive soundtrack
► 50 levels with personal bests
► Special rewards for top runs


STONE RUN - Just run & jump! Escape from the huge stone.
Features:
► Non-stop arcade action
► Hand-drawn retro cartoon visuals
► Simple, fun mechanics
► Boombastic soundtrack
► Built for “just one more run”


PIRATE BLOOPERS - A minimalist time-survival game: fend off pesky pirates and outlast endless waves. Pick your flag and ship color, take aim with your trusty crossbow, and ride the tailwind. Scoop up gold to upgrade your boat. All hands on deck!
Features:
► Simple & intuitive controls
► Survive endless waves of enemies
► Upgrade shop: spend in-game gold on boosts & unlocks
► Sunny, beach-style HD visuals
► Deep, ambient soundtrack
► Tons of pirate GOLD!


BEAT of MONTEZUMA - A rhythm game with 80s vibes and a fresh portal-labyrinth twist. Traverse the maze of a mysterious supreme idol and collect every coin. Don’t waste time - feel the rhythm of Montezuma!
Features:
► Unique experimental gameplay
► Punchy 8-bit soundtrack
► Retro vibes
► 50 levels
► Super bonuses for flawless runs


BALLOTRON - Unlock your talent in a skill-based arcade puzzler with crisp bounces and trick shots. The goal is simple: make the Blue Ball touch the Green Ball. Fire small balls to move larger ones and interact with blocks, chain ricochets to find elegant solutions, and earn Stars while collecting special Golden Coins to unlock super prizes.
Features:
► Unique, experimental mechanics
► Colorful HD visuals with a relaxing soundtrack
► Clean, responsive physics for clever trick shots
► 50 unique levels
► Super prizes for collecting Stars and Golden Coins
► Track and beat your personal bests


BALLOTRON: OCEANS - The next Ballotron chapter, now underwater. You still shoot balls, but every puzzle plays out beneath the waves. The goal is simple: make the Blue Ball touch the Green Ball. Launch small balls to nudge larger ones and burst Bubble Blocks, finding even more playful solutions. Collect Stars and special Golden Coins to push your high scores.
Features:
► Bubble-Block physics with satisfying pops
► 50 new relaxing levels
► HD visuals with a new meditative soundtrack
► Super prizes for collecting Stars and Golden Coins
► Improve your best on each level


BALLOTRON: COOL BOX - Christmas comes to Ballotron in a cozy, festive chapter. Fire small balls to move the big ones and connect the two large balls to clear each level. Break ice blocks, enjoy the feel of winter and presents, and use portal mechanics to discover new solutions. Collect Stars and Golden Coins to push your best scores.
Features:
► Colorful HD visuals with Christmas music
► New ICE blocks and Portal gates
► 50 new handcrafted levels
► Prizes for collecting Stars and Golden Coins
► Track and beat your personal bests


BALLOTRON: GALAXY - A cosmic twist on your favorite arcade puzzler. Blast into space and prove your aim. Fire small balls to move larger ones and interact with blocks. Discover clever ways to connect the Blue and Green balls, then experiment with strategies to crack tough, logic-driven puzzles.
Features:
► Wild bounces with bumping springs
► HD visuals with a fresh, stylish soundtrack
► Magnets and new breakable blocks
► 30 new challenging levels
► Prizes for collecting Stars and Golden Coins
short_desc: Cool Game Pack is a collection of high-quality mini games with retro vibes and offers an unique blend of logic, physics, and reflex-based. Unwind and engage your mind with fun, just like in the good old days!
